information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LopesUpAZFall2026#78850-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab. #### This competition is FREE for current GCU students! Please email the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact/website?competitionId=LopesUpAZFall2026) a photo of your student ID and we will manually accept your registration (do not pay the registration fee, please). ## This competition is hosted by the GCU Cubing Club ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAzNDYwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d173eedc9ebf7baf44d0ad33f35fc469c6ac70e8/GCU_Cubing_Club_Logo.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAzNDY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--98174d92f4e3746acc7201ee5095d394b25e28fe/ArizonaCubingLogo.png) ### Connect with the Arizona cubing community!
